What the sample includes

Up to three completed pull-request runs and three completed push runs per UW repository from the past 14 days. The sample is collected twice a day. Live workflows update separately on the review desk.

Pre-start is the interval from job creation to start. It includes dependencies, approvals and scheduling. Runtime measures time on a runner. The p95 is the time within which 95% of sampled jobs fell. Skipped jobs, jobs without assigned runtime and jobs carried forward from earlier attempts are excluded.
